scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @godavari/shared build && concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @godavari/api dev" "pnpm --filter @godavari/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @godavari/shared build && pnpm --filter @godavari/api build && pnpm --filter @godavari/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @godavari/shared build && pnpm --filter @godavari/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @godavari/web typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @godavari/shared build && pnpm --filter @godavari/shared test && pnpm --filter @godavari/api test && pnpm --filter @godavari/web test && pnpm db:smoke
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm security:bundle
